Job description 

For our client, a renowned logistics company, we are looking for a motivated and experienced C Driver for the distribution center in Merelbeke. As a C Driver, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently transporting goods to various locations in East and West Flanders.

Tasks and responsibilities:

    
• Loading and unloading goods (various, food (including alcohol) and non-food) on pallets using an electric pallet truck.
    
• Safely and timely delivering goods to customers in East and West Flanders.
    
• Correctly filling out freight documents and maintaining administration.
    
• Maintaining and keeping the truck clean.
    
• Adhering to traffic rules and safety regulations.
    
• Providing customer-friendly service.

 Requirements 

    
• In possession of a valid driver's license C and code 95. Experience as a C Chauffeur, preferably in distribution.
    
• Good knowledge of the roads in East and West Flanders.
    
• Physically fit and able to load and unload independently.
    
• Customer-oriented, flexible, and reliable.
    
• Able to work independently.
    
• You speak good Dutch, French, or English.

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of analog and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

Ready for the next step in your engineering career? At Agfa, you'll take ownership of automation projects that have a direct impact on a high-tech production environment.
Your role
 

As a Project Engineer Automation, you lead the design and implementation of automation solutions—from concept to commissioning.

You translate technical challenges into smart, scalable systems, combining hardware and software into robust solutions used daily on the production floor.

You manage projects end-to-end, while staying close to the technology. This is not a purely coordinating role—you remain hands-on and technically involved.
What you'll be doing
 
 
• Lead automation projects from concept to implementation 
• Design and develop innovative hardware and software solutions 
• Optimize existing machines and processes to improve performance and reliability 
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders (engineering, production, maintenance) 
• Ensure smooth implementation and support adoption on the shop floor 
• Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation initiatives Why this role stands out
 
 
• Real ownership of projects—not just a supporting role 
• Strong combination of technical depth and project responsibility 
• Direct impact on production and visible results of your work 
• Clear growth opportunities towards senior expert or project leadership Interested?
 

Looking for a role where you can truly make an impact and keep growing? Let's connect—we'd be happy to explore this opportunity together.

Your profile
 
 
• Master's degree in Engineering (e.g. Electromechanics, Automation, Computer Science, …) 
• Preferably 3-5 years of experience in automation, engineering, or a technical project environment 
• Strong interest in integrating hardware and software 
• Hands-on, analytical, and solution-oriented 
• Able to take ownership and drive projects forward 
• Good communicator and team player 
• Fluent in Dutch and English

Your Future at 3CON

The 3CON Group is an internationally successful hidden champion in plant engineering and special-purpose machinery. For many years, we have been developing high-end solutions for the automotive industry, the life sciences sector, and other demanding industries.

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed and creative individual to join us as a:

Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Pharma / Biopharma Industry

Your Responsibilities:

● Performance & Web: End-to-end management and optimization of LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and SEO (WordPress).

● Lead Pipeline: Structured qualification and handoff of marketing leads to our international sales team.

● Content: Creation of white papers, case studies, and web content tailored for B2B decision-makers.

● Budget & ROI: Ongoing monitoring and tracking of all campaign and event budgets.

Your Profile:

● Experience: At least 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B digital marketing—preferably within an industrial, technical, or life sciences background.

● Tech Stack: Demonstrated proficiency with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, GA4, WordPress, and CRM platforms.

● Mindset: Strong technical aptitude to translate complex concepts into high-impact content.

● Languages: Native or full professional fluency in English (primary working language) alongside strong business-level German.

● Project Management: Proven ability to manage budgets, meet complex deadlines, and execute international trade show projects seamlessly.

What We Offer:

● Challenging tasks in an international environment with flexible working-time models.

● State-of-the-art workplaces designed to the latest ergonomic standards.

● Individual development paths through a wide range of internal and external training opportunities.

● The opportunity for assignments abroad at our plants (Mexico, China, USA), including special bonuses.

● An in-house 3CON Health Center with a company doctor, sports offerings, and subsidized therapeutic massages (50% covered).

● An excellent company restaurant serving freshly prepared, regional dishes at preferential prices.

● A genuine team spirit fostered through regular sports, team-building, and social events.

● Exclusive employee benefits (including bike leasing and discounts with partner companies such as Hagebau and the Inntal Logistics Park).

● Compensation is based on the collective agreement for the metal industry. As we set high standards for top performance, we are expressly willing to pay significantly above this baseline — your actual salary will be agreed individually, based on your qualifications and professional experience.
